P01.rationale: No human portrait or founder image appears anywhere on the page; it is entirely text-based.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections with client portraits; the page contains only numbered argument blocks.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonials are present on this page.

P10.rationale: The large numerals '1', '2', '3' function as oversized section markers but are modest in scale and not truly giant ghost/decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: While statistics are cited in the text, there are no visual data-visualisations, charts, before/after graphics, or cost-math diagrams.

P12.rationale: The layout is clean and structured but relatively sparse, with a large empty region at the bottom third of the page and no visual density typical of magazine-quality editorial design.

P13.rationale: The light blue header band provides a minimal atmospheric element, but the rest of the page is flat white with no texture or atmospheric treatment.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so scrim treatment is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page uses no imagery at all, so stock-photo genericness is not an issue, though the absence of any specific visuals keeps it generic by default.

N08.rationale: A large, clearly empty region occupies the bottom quarter to third of the page with no content, representing significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: There are no photos on the page, so text-over-busy-photo or awkward inset gap issues do not arise.
